name: discord
description: Post notifications to a Discord channel as your bot, and read your server's public online count for the community badge. Fixture-verified; not live-verified.
author: Papercusp

credentials.label: Discord bot token
credentials.help: Create an application, add a bot, copy its token, and invite the bot to your server with the Send Messages permission. The host stores the token and sends it as Authorization: Bot.

channelId.title: Channel ID
channelId.description: The text channel notifications are posted to.

guildId.title: Server ID
guildId.description: Your server. Needed for the online-count badge and for message links.

inviteUrl.title: Invite link
inviteUrl.description: An https://discord.gg/… invite shown on the community badge.
